ex.en: Young children cannot always differentiate between fact and fantasy.
ex.zh: 幼儿并不总能区分事实与幻想。

words.note: differentiate 后接 between 或 from，表区分。

ex.en: Please contact the office if your address changes.
ex.zh: 如果你的地址有变，请联系办公室。

words.note: contact 作动词不接 to，直接 contact sb。

ex.en: Workers in the factory must wear protective garments at all times.
ex.zh: 工厂工人必须始终穿着防护服。

words.note: garment 是正式用词，指单件衣物。

ex.en: The factory was fined for discharging waste into the river.
ex.zh: 这家工厂因向河中排放废物被罚款。

words.note: discharge 指排放或释放，也可指出院。

ex.en: Nobody should be excluded from the club because of their background.
ex.zh: 不应因背景而把任何人排除在俱乐部之外。

words.note: exclude 反义词 include，名词 exclusion。

ex.en: Walking home alone at night can be scary for young people.
ex.zh: 夜里独自步行回家对年轻人来说可能很可怕。

words.note: scary 多用于口语，书面可用 frightening。

ex.en: The plan drew sharp criticism from local residents.
ex.zh: 该计划招致当地居民的尖锐批评。

words.note: criticism 后接 of，动词是 criticize。

ex.en: The lecture enlightened us about the causes of climate change.
ex.zh: 这场讲座让我们了解了气候变化的成因。

words.note: enlighten sb on/about sth 表使某人明白。

ex.en: Safety is of the utmost importance when working at heights.
ex.zh: 高空作业时，安全至关重要。

words.note: do one's utmost to do 表竭尽全力。

ex.en: The house was shown to prospective buyers over the weekend.
ex.zh: 周末带潜在买家看了这套房子。

words.note: prospective 指未来可能的，如潜在买家。

ex.en: A small amount is deducted from your salary each month for insurance.
ex.zh: 每月从你工资中扣除一小笔钱用于保险。

words.note: deduct 常搭 from；名词 deduction。

ex.en: He broke his wrist and had to wear a plaster cast for six weeks.
ex.zh: 他手腕骨折，打了六周石膏。

words.note: 英式 plaster 指创可贴；plaster cast 是石膏。

ex.en: She left the bank to join a small management consultancy.
ex.zh: 她离开银行，加入一家小型管理咨询公司。

words.note: consultancy 指咨询公司或服务，consultant 是顾问。

ex.en: House prices in the metropolitan area have risen sharply.
ex.zh: 大都市区的房价大幅上涨。

words.note: metropolitan 指大城市的，名词 metropolis。

ex.en: The film portrays the scientist as a lonely but brilliant man.
ex.zh: 影片把这位科学家描绘成一个孤独而杰出的人。

words.note: portray sb as 表把某人描绘成。

ex.en: Someone has to take out the garbage before the truck arrives.
ex.zh: 得有人赶在垃圾车来之前把垃圾拿出去。

words.note: garbage 是美式用词，英式多用 rubbish。

ex.en: The guards became suspicious of the man standing by the gate.
ex.zh: 警卫对站在门口的那个男人起了疑心。

words.note: be suspicious of sb 表怀疑某人。

ex.en: She spent the morning scrubbing the kitchen floor by hand.
ex.zh: 她一上午都在用手擦洗厨房地板。

words.note: scrub 指用力刷洗，也指取消计划。

ex.en: Several guests complained about the noise from the street.
ex.zh: 几位客人抱怨街上的噪音。

words.note: complain about sth；向某人投诉用 to sb。

ex.en: The population of the town is small and fairly homogeneous.
ex.zh: 这个镇的人口不多，且相当单一。

words.note: homogeneous 反义 heterogeneous，homo 表相同。

ex.en: The report affirms the importance of early education for children.
ex.zh: 报告肯定了幼儿早期教育的重要性。

words.note: affirm 指明确肯定，名词 affirmation。

ex.en: The invention of printing had a profound effect on European society.
ex.zh: 印刷术的发明对欧洲社会产生了深远影响。

words.note: profound 指影响深远或见解深刻，比 deep 正式。

ex.en: The hall has a marble floor and a high painted ceiling.
ex.zh: 大厅铺着大理石地面，有高高的彩绘天花板。

words.note: marble 作材料不可数，作弹珠可数 marbles。

ex.en: Many students feel anxiety about finding a job after graduation.
ex.zh: 许多学生对毕业后找工作感到焦虑。

words.note: anxiety 后接 about/over，形容词 anxious。

ex.en: It took her a few weeks to adjust to the new climate.
ex.zh: 她花了几周时间才适应新气候。

words.note: adjust to sth 表适应；adjust sth 表调节。

ex.en: Her aspiration is to become a doctor in her home village.
ex.zh: 她的志向是在家乡当一名医生。

words.note: aspiration 常用复数表志向，后接 to do。

ex.en: Doctors recommend at least thirty minutes of vigorous exercise daily.
ex.zh: 医生建议每天至少进行三十分钟的剧烈运动。

words.note: vigorous 指有力或精力充沛，名词 vigour。

ex.en: She has been a vocal critic of the plan since it was announced.
ex.zh: 该计划公布以来，她一直是直言不讳的批评者。

words.note: vocal 也指敢于直言的；vocal cords 指声带。

ex.en: The building was deemed unsafe and closed to the public.
ex.zh: 该建筑被认为不安全，已对公众关闭。

words.note: deem 是正式用词，常用 deem sth + adj.。

ex.en: The book traces the origin of the ancient festival.
ex.zh: 这本书追溯了这个古老节日的起源。

words.note: origin 常与 of 连用；original 指最初的。
